mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies and 50 degrees at Verona Community Park, though the air quality is moderate. The moon is a waxing gibbous, and the ISS will be visible tomorrow morning starting at 5:45 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and moving toward the northeast near the Madison Home Depot. Tonight, the low will hit 44 degrees with no rain predicted.

The city has been busy with infrastructure updates. Phase two of the Mark Drive reconstruction is moving along, with utility work finished and concrete pouring now in progress. Additionally, residents are encouraged to utilize the Eye-On-Water program to track usage or check the public works website for information on the toilet rebate program.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with trivia at Hop Haus Brewing or Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Tomorrow, you can catch more trivia at The Bogey Factory or enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, and be sure to check out the ART House 360 events starting this Thursday.

On October 15th, the Verona Police Department responded to reports of erratic driving and subsequently arrested a school bus driver for O W I. Officers confirmed no injuries occurred during the event and are continuing their investigation.

We have finished serving today's flavor, which was the rich Devil's Food Cake. The store is now closed, so please join us tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM, when we will be featuring the Chocolate Covered Strawberry flavor.
